figs.name: 2oo3-voting-logic-transmitter-voter-diagram
figs.alt: 2oo3 voting logic diagram with three transmitters tripping at 100 bar
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing three pressure transmitters compared with a 100 bar trip setting, where two high readings make the 2oo3 voter trip the plant.
figs.after_h2: How 2oo3 Voting Logic works in real systems

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">

<text x="322.0" y="114.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Above 100 bar?</text>
<text x="322.0" y="138.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">HIGH</text>
<line x1="414" y1="120" x2="471" y2="200" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>

<text x="105.0" y="234.15" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">PT2</text>
<text x="105.0" y="259.15" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">103 bar</text>
<line x1="182" y1="240" x2="228" y2="240" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="232" y="200" width="180" height="80" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="322.0" y="234.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Above 100 bar?</text>
<text x="322.0" y="258.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">HIGH</text>
<line x1="414" y1="240" x2="471" y2="240" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="436" y="230" font-size="20" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
<rect x="30" y="320" width="150" height="80" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="105.0" y="354.15" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">PT3</text>
<text x="105.0" y="379.15" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">92 bar</text>
<line x1="182" y1="360" x2="228" y2="360" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="232" y="320" width="180" height="80" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="322.0" y="354.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Above 100 bar?</text>
<text x="322.0" y="378.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">NORMAL</text>
<line x1="414" y1="360" x2="471" y2="280" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="436" y="388" font-size="20" fill="#16a34a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">0</text>
<rect x="475" y="180" width="140" height="120" rx="10" fill="#7c3aed" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="545.0" y="221.65" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2oo3</text>
<text x="545.0" y="246.65" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">voter</text>
<text x="545.0" y="271.65" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">2 of 3 high</text>
<line x1="617" y1="240" x2="650" y2="240" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>

<rect x="30" y="430" width="750" height="54" rx="10" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="405.0" y="462.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Two transmitters agree on high pressure, so the condition is real and the system trips</text>

figs.name: 2oo3-voting-logic-trip-decision-flowchart
figs.alt: 2oo3 voting logic flowchart showing no trip for one high sensor and trip for two
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the 2oo3 decision: no high readings keep running, one high reading is ignored as a faulty sensor, and two or three high readings trip.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 540" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>2oo3 voting logic decision flowchart counting transmitters above the trip setting</title>
<rect width="800" height="540" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">How a 2oo3 Voter Decides</text>
<rect x="200" y="58" width="400" height="56" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="91.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">PT1, PT2, PT3 measure the same pressure</text>
<line x1="400" y1="116" x2="400" y2="138" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="200" y="140" width="400" height="56" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="173.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Compare each reading with the trip setting</text>
<line x1="400" y1="198" x2="400" y2="220" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,222.0 570.0,280 400,338.0 230.0,280" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="275.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">How many above</text>
<text x="400" y="297.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">the setting?</text>
<polyline points="230,280 130,280 130,360" fill="none" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="175" y="268" font-size="20" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">0</text>
<line x1="400" y1="338" x2="400" y2="360" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="418" y="356" font-size="20" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
<polyline points="570,280 670,280 670,360" fill="none" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="625" y="268" font-size="18" fill="#b91c1c" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2 or 3</text>
<rect x="30" y="365" width="200" height="90" rx="10" fill="#dcfce7" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="130.0" y="404.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Normal</text>
<text x="130.0" y="428.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">keep running</text>
<rect x="285" y="365" width="230" height="90" rx="10" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="392.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Ignore it</text>
<text x="400.0" y="415.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">one faulty sensor</text>
<text x="400.0" y="438.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">cannot trip</text>
<rect x="570" y="365" width="200" height="90" rx="10" fill="#fee2e2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="670.0" y="404.3" font-size="18" fill="#b91c1c" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Real condition</text>
<text x="670.0" y="428.3" font-size="18" fill="#b91c1c" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">system trips</text>
<text x="400" y="500" font-size="18" fill="#4c1d95" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Fewer false trips, and one sensor can be under maintenance</text>
</svg>
